_comment: Arms trained on the regenerated v0.5.4 data (refusal twins, verifier gate, holdout-aware), scored on the v0.5.4 key beside the v053cmp arms. Build the split first: cb.py split -c config_kr_v054_gen.json --out-train ../ground_truth_v054/train_gen054. The equal-size arm and its seed repeats test whether the abstention variance of v0.5.3 (8%/18%/84% across seeds) is gone. Legacy prompt layout, so the arms are comparable with v053cmp. Run with run_experiment.sh experiments/exp_v054data.json.

../ground_truth_v054/train_gen054/train_._why: the v0.5.4 STaR rows at the v0.5.2 count, for the equal-size comparison
